1. Official Class Quizzes.qE: Which of the following is FALSE regarding cutting machining (절삭가공)?
1. Official Class Quizzes.eE: Standard cutting tools are designed for metals. Rubber is too elastic and ceramics are too brittle to be easily machined.
1. Official Class Quizzes.eK: 절삭가공에 사용되는 일반적인 공구로는 도자기나 고무 가공이 어렵습니다.

1. Official Class Quizzes.qE: Which of the following is FALSE regarding production automation (생산자동화)?
1. Official Class Quizzes.eE: Automation specifically exists to eliminate the reliance on manual human labor through unmanned systems.
1. Official Class Quizzes.eK: 생산자동화는 인간의 노동력 의존을 줄이고 무인화를 목표로 합니다.

2. Learning Material Concepts.qE: According to the Kimchi-jjigae analogy, what is the absolute foundation of a manufactured product?
2. Learning Material Concepts.qK: 김치찌개 비유에 따르면, 제품 제조에서 가장 기초가 되는 것은 무엇인가?
2. Learning Material Concepts.eE: Just like fresh ingredients make a good stew, selecting the correct raw materials based on the engineering drawing is the foundation of manufacturing.
2. Learning Material Concepts.eK: 좋은 재료가 맛있는 찌개를 만들 듯이, 도면에 맞는 원재료 선택이 제조의 핵심입니다.

2. Learning Material Concepts.qE: Which of the following represents the correct formula for Mechatronics?
2. Learning Material Concepts.eE: Mechatronics is the integration of mechanical engineering (the muscles) and electronic engineering (the brains).

3. MAIA's Predicted Exam Questions.qE: Which components act as the 'brain' and the 'body' of a Smart Factory?
3. MAIA's Predicted Exam Questions.qK: 스마트 팩토리에서 두뇌와 몸통 역할을 하는 시스템은?
3. MAIA's Predicted Exam Questions.eE: Engineers write programs on the PLC (brains) and interface them with the FMS (body) to run the factory automatically.
3. MAIA's Predicted Exam Questions.eK: 엔지니어가 PLC에 프로그램을 작성하고 FMS와 연동하여 공장을 자동화합니다.

1. Official Class Quizzes.qE: Which of the following is NOT included in non-ferrous metals?
1. Official Class Quizzes.eE: Cast Iron literally contains iron and a high amount of carbon (>2.1%), making it a ferrous (steel) material.
1. Official Class Quizzes.eK: 주철은 철과 다량의 탄소(2.1% 이상)를 포함하고 있으므로 철강재료(철금속)입니다.

1. Official Class Quizzes.qE: Which heat treatment increases toughness, stabilizes the structure, and relieves stress?
1. Official Class Quizzes.qK: 인성증가, 조직의 안정화, 스트레스 제거를 목적으로 하는 열처리는?
1. Official Class Quizzes.eE: Tempering is done after Quenching to relieve internal stress and bring back the material's toughness so it doesn't shatter.
1. Official Class Quizzes.eK: 뜨임은 담금질 후 내부 응력을 제거하고 인성을 회복시키기 위해 수행됩니다.

2. Learning Material Concepts.qE: According to the POSCO rolling mill example, which property allows massive steel blocks to be squeezed into thin flat sheets?
2. Learning Material Concepts.qK: 포스코 압연기 사례에서, 두꺼운 철판을 얇게 펴게 해주는 성질은?
2. Learning Material Concepts.eE: Malleability allows metal to be flattened or rolled into sheets. Ductility is pulling it into wires.
2. Learning Material Concepts.eK: 전성(퍼짐성)은 금속을 얇게 펼 수 있는 성질입니다.

2. Learning Material Concepts.qE: In the Fe-C phase diagram, what carbon percentage separates Steel from Cast Iron?
2. Learning Material Concepts.qK: 철-탄소 상태도에서 강과 주철을 구분하는 탄소 함유량 경계는?
2. Learning Material Concepts.eE: 2.1% or less is Steel. 2.1% or more is Cast Iron.
2. Learning Material Concepts.eK: 탄소 함유량 2.1%를 기준으로 그 이하는 강(Steel), 이상은 주철(Cast Iron)입니다.

3. MAIA's Predicted Exam Questions.qE: Why is it important to understand that a car has 30,000 parts when studying materials?
3. MAIA's Predicted Exam Questions.qK: 재료를 공부할 때 자동차가 3만 개의 부품으로 이루어져 있다는 사실이 중요한 이유는?
3. MAIA's Predicted Exam Questions.eE: An engine block needs heat resistance, while an axle needs toughness. Different functions require careful material selection.
3. MAIA's Predicted Exam Questions.eK: 각 부품마다 고열 견딤, 충격 흡수 등 요구되는 기계적 성질이 다르기 때문입니다.

1. Official Class Quizzes.qE: Which of the following is NOT a method for measuring material hardness?
1. Official Class Quizzes.eE: Charpy is an impact test used to measure Toughness, not Hardness.
1. Official Class Quizzes.eK: 샤르피는 경도가 아닌 인성(Toughness)을 측정하는 충격 시험입니다.

1. Official Class Quizzes.qE: The property of returning to its original state when an external force is removed is elasticity. (True/False)
1. Official Class Quizzes.qK: 외력을 제거하면 원래 상태로 되돌아가는 성질은 탄성이다. (O/X)
1. Official Class Quizzes.eE: This is the exact definition of Elasticity. If it stays bent, it is Plasticity.
1. Official Class Quizzes.eK: 탄성의 정확한 정의입니다. 원래 모양으로 돌아가지 않으면 소성(Plasticity)입니다.

2. Learning Material Concepts.qE: Which test literally pulls the material apart to find its yield point and breaking point?
2. Learning Material Concepts.qK: 재료의 항복점과 파단점을 찾기 위해 재료를 잡아당기는 시험은?
2. Learning Material Concepts.eE: Tensile testing (인장 시험) pulls the specimen apart to measure tensile strength and yield point.
2. Learning Material Concepts.eK: 인장 시험은 재료를 양쪽에서 잡아당겨 인장강도와 항복점을 측정합니다.

3. MAIA's Predicted Exam Questions.qE: Which testing method is critical for checking if a train wheel will fail over millions of rotations?
3. MAIA's Predicted Exam Questions.qK: 수백만 번 회전하는 기차 바퀴가 파괴될지 확인하는 데 가장 중요한 시험은?
3. MAIA's Predicted Exam Questions.eE: Fatigue testing finds the 'Fatigue Limit'—how much repeated, cyclic stress a material can take before failing.
3. MAIA's Predicted Exam Questions.eK: 반복되는 응력에 재료가 견디는 한계를 알아내는 피로 시험이 필수적입니다.

1. Official Class Quizzes.qE: Which of the following is NOT a standard/normal microstructure of steel?
1. Official Class Quizzes.eE: Martensite is an artificially forced, heat-treated structure created only by rapid quenching.
1. Official Class Quizzes.eK: 마르텐사이트는 정상적인 냉각이 아닌 급랭에 의해서만 생성되는 인위적인 열처리 조직입니다.

1. Official Class Quizzes.qE: A graph showing state changes while slowly cooling, with element ratio on the X-axis and temp on the Y-axis, is a phase diagram. (True/False)
1. Official Class Quizzes.qK: 가로축은 원소비율, 세로축은 온도로 서서히 냉각시 상태변화를 나타낸 것은 평행상태도이다. (O/X)
1. Official Class Quizzes.eE: This correctly defines the Fe-C Phase diagram.

2. Learning Material Concepts.qE: Which crystal lattice structure is the most ductile (flexible), making materials like Copper and Aluminum easy to shape?
2. Learning Material Concepts.qK: 구리와 알루미늄처럼 가공하기 쉬우며 가장 연성이 좋은 결정격자 구조는?
2. Learning Material Concepts.eE: FCC (Face-Centered Cubic) is the most flexible/ductile atomic arrangement. Memory hook: FCC = Flexible.
2. Learning Material Concepts.eK: 면심입방격자(FCC)는 가장 연성이 좋아 변형이 쉽습니다.

3. MAIA's Predicted Exam Questions.qE: At what specific point on the phase diagram does Austenite transform into layered Pearlite?
3. MAIA's Predicted Exam Questions.qK: 상태도에서 오스테나이트가 펄라이트로 변태하는 특정 지점은?
3. MAIA's Predicted Exam Questions.eE: The magic Eutectoid point (공석점) occurs at exactly 0.8% Carbon and 727°C.

1. Official Class Quizzes.qE: Which of the following is NOT an advantage of casting?
1. Official Class Quizzes.eE: Casting actually makes alloying extremely easy because the metals are already liquids before pouring.
1. Official Class Quizzes.eK: 주조는 금속을 액체 상태로 녹이기 때문에 합금 작업이 매우 쉽습니다.

2. Learning Material Concepts.qE: Roughly what percentage of an automobile's parts are made using casting?
2. Learning Material Concepts.qK: 자동차 부품의 약 몇 퍼센트가 주조를 통해 만들어지는가?
2. Learning Material Concepts.eE: About 30% of a car (like the massive engine block) relies on casting to form complex heavy shapes.
2. Learning Material Concepts.eK: 크고 복잡한 엔진 블록 등을 만들기 위해 자동차 부품의 약 30%가 주조로 제작됩니다.

3. MAIA's Predicted Exam Questions.qE: Which special machining process is best for cutting extremely hardened metals using electrical sparks?
3. MAIA's Predicted Exam Questions.qK: 열처리로 너무 단단해진 금속을 전기 불꽃을 이용해 가공하는 특수가공법은?
3. MAIA's Predicted Exam Questions.eE: Electrical Discharge Machining (EDM - 방전가공) melts hard metals using thousands of sparks per second.
3. MAIA's Predicted Exam Questions.eK: 방전가공(EDM)은 전기 스파크를 이용해 매우 단단한 금속을 깎아냅니다.

1. Official Class Quizzes.qE: Non-ferrous materials like copper are good conductors, resist corrosion, and include brass and bronze. (True/False)
1. Official Class Quizzes.qK: 비철재료 중 동은 양도체이며 부식에 강하고, 합금으로는 황동과 청동이 있다. (O/X)
1. Official Class Quizzes.eE: This is a perfect definition of Copper. Remember, Brass = Cu+Zn, Bronze = Cu+Sn.

2. Learning Material Concepts.qE: What is the key difference between Hot Working and Cold Working?
2. Learning Material Concepts.qK: 열간 가공과 냉간 가공을 구분하는 가장 중요한 기준은?
2. Learning Material Concepts.eE: Hot working is done above the recrystallization temperature; cold working is done below it.
2. Learning Material Concepts.eK: 재결정 온도를 기준으로 그 이상이면 열간 가공, 이하이면 냉간 가공입니다.

3. MAIA's Predicted Exam Questions.qE: Which plastic working process pushes hot metal out of a shaped die like squeezing toothpaste?
3. MAIA's Predicted Exam Questions.qK: 치약을 짜는 것처럼 가열된 금속을 형틀(다이)로 밀어내어 뽑아내는 가공법은?
3. MAIA's Predicted Exam Questions.eE: Extrusion (압출) is pushing/squeezing. Drawing (인발) is pulling into a wire.
3. MAIA's Predicted Exam Questions.eK: 압출(Extrusion)은 밀어내는 방식이며, 인발(Drawing)은 당겨서 선을 뽑는 방식입니다.

1. Official Class Quizzes.qE: The discipline of manufacturing useful machines by transforming materials is mechanical manufacturing. (True/False)
1. Official Class Quizzes.qK: 각종재료를 변형시켜 유용한 기계를 제작하는 학문은 기계공작법이다. (O/X)
1. Official Class Quizzes.eE: This is the exact textbook definition for Mechanical Manufacturing.

2. Learning Material Concepts.qE: Which machine tool creates cylindrical shapes by spinning the actual workpiece against a stationary tool?
2. Learning Material Concepts.qK: 고정된 공구에 가공물 자체를 회전시켜 원통형 모양을 깎아내는 공작기계는?
2. Learning Material Concepts.eE: In a Lathe (선반), the metal workpiece spins. In Milling, the cutter spins.
2. Learning Material Concepts.eK: 선반(Lathe)은 가공물이 회전하고, 밀링(Milling)은 공구가 회전합니다.

3. MAIA's Predicted Exam Questions.qE: Which process is typically used at the very end to achieve a mirror-like precision finish?
3. MAIA's Predicted Exam Questions.qK: 가장 마지막 단계에서 거울처럼 정밀한 표면을 얻기 위해 숫돌을 사용하는 가공은?
3. MAIA's Predicted Exam Questions.eE: Grinding (연삭) uses an abrasive wheel to remove tiny amounts of material for a perfect finish.
3. MAIA's Predicted Exam Questions.eK: 연삭가공(Grinding)은 숫돌바퀴를 사용하여 초정밀 표면을 완성합니다.
